description: Temporal Knowledge Contract for Frontier Global Lab canonical knowledge.

field_semantics.id: Stable canonical knowledge identifier. Must not change when the document content is revised.
field_semantics.knowledge_type: Knowledge category used to determine temporal behavior and review policy.
field_semantics.created_at: Date when this canonical knowledge asset was first created.
field_semantics.as_of: The real-world date through which the document's current knowledge state is intended to be valid. This is not the file modification date.
field_semantics.last_verified_at: Date when the document's important factual content was most recently reviewed against suitable evidence.
field_semantics.next_review_at: Date after which the document should be treated as requiring freshness review.
field_semantics.supersedes: Optional ID of an older canonical knowledge asset that this document formally replaces.
field_semantics.superseded_by: Optional ID of the canonical knowledge asset that formally replaces this document.
field_semantics.review_provenance: Audit metadata describing who performed the review, the review basis, the review scope, supporting research run snapshots, and the review rationale. Document-level activation currently requires full_document scope.

status_semantics.active: Current canonical knowledge and within its intended review lifecycle.
status_semantics.needs_review: Canonical knowledge remains available but its freshness or factual validity requires review.
status_semantics.superseded: The document has been formally replaced by another canonical knowledge asset.
status_semantics.historical: The document is intentionally retained as a historical state and is not presented as current knowledge.

rules: Git history records document revisions; temporal metadata records real-world validity.
as_of must not be automatically replaced by file modification time.
A document may remain active even when individual claims later require review.
Document-level status contradicted is not supported in schema v0.1.0; contradiction belongs to claim-level lifecycle.
supersedes and superseded_by are used only for formal replacement of canonical knowledge assets, not routine edits.
Templates, reference documents, and system documentation do not require freshness review.
Decision logs use item-level dates and lifecycle rather than document-level freshness metadata.
Agent-generated drafts must not become canonical temporal knowledge without human promotion.

timezone.semantics: Human-facing project dates and timestamps use China Standard Time / Asia/Shanghai. Temporal knowledge date fields are interpreted using the project timezone unless a source explicitly carries another timezone.
